capabilities: Build virtual folder dimensions from frontmatter date and path properties
Display each dimension in the left sidebar, right sidebar, or both
Drag Markdown notes into virtual folders to write the folder path into frontmatter
Rename, re-icon, and delete virtual folders or categories from a context menu
Sort each dimension by name, created time, or modified time in ascending or descending order
disambiguation: Not a file manager; virtual folders only update frontmatter and never move, rename, or delete real files in the vault.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README gives BRAT and offline zip installation steps for use before community store approval. Frontmatter paths must exist virtually; temporary virtual paths can be created without real folders.
problem: Obsidian notes live in a single real folder hierarchy, so organizing the same notes by date, project, source, and topic at once requires duplicating files or constantly moving them.
summary: Builds multiple virtual folder trees from note frontmatter, letting each note appear in several hierarchies without moving real files.
